title: Patch: full-art cards in your hand show only their art, no name
thread:
**Issue #2723 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2723: Patch: full-art cards in your hand show only their art, no name
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

## What it does

A full-art card (R1017001, at any tier of R2655000) in its owner's hand prints its name banner across the foot of the art (`apps/web/src/cards/cards.css`, `.cf[data-full-art="true"] .card-name`, kept at hand size by the "full-art face keeps its art across the whole face at hand size" rule). Its rarity gem and set mark show too, and a Mythic also signs its name across the art.

In the hand, the owner wants it to be **just a tiny version of the art**: the player already knows what the card is.

**What changes in your own hand:** a full-art face drops its name banner, its Mythic signature, its rarity gem, its set mark and its crest. #2718's watermark never applies, since a full-art face has no rules box.

**What stays:**

- the cost gem, with its live cost and tone, because a cost can change in hand;
- a Unit's attack and health, which can change in hand too;
- every state the hand draws: playable, can't play, selected, dragged, Radiant;
- the full-art tier's motion (#2715), and any finish (#2720), border or foil the card wears.

**Unchanged elsewhere:** the hover preview and the inspect overlay show the whole card with its name, and so does every view outside the hand: the board, mulligan and discover choices (where the player is choosing), the deck builder, the Collection and the Almanac.

**Accessibility:** the name stays in the card's accessible name (`aria-label` and `title`), so a screen reader and the tooltip still say what it is.

**Scope:** only your own hand is affected. The opponent's hand is face down, and a card they reveal is not in your hand.

This is presentation only (CLAUDE.md rule 7), so it takes a ruling note in this issue's block, amending R1017001. It changes how cards look, so a pending fragment claims it (a micro, R2529000).

## Acceptance

- A full-art card in the viewer's hand renders no visible name, signature, rarity gem, set mark or crest, but does render its cost gem and, for a Unit, its stats (`CardFace.test.tsx`).
- The same card in mulligan, discover, inspect, hover preview, on the board and in the Collection renders its name as today.
- A non-full-art card in hand is unchanged.
- The card's accessible name still holds its name in the hand.
- A component (pixel) spec shows a hand holding a full-art Unit, a full-art Spell and a normal card.
- The ruling note passes `cargo jackioh spec check`, and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` passes with the fragment.

## Blocked by, part of

Nothing blocks it. It touches the full-art face beside #2715; whichever lands second merges main first.
```
